q: we carried out a large-scale survey aimed at how AI assistants are used

r: Include: survey of coding agents with a taxonomy of development models including Planning-Driven and Context-Enhanced, relevant to RQ1 and RQ4.

q: we first construct an evolution-aware repository-level code generation dataset

q: We audit 2,385 retained task-to-score traces from 15 agent benchmarks spanning web research, software repair, repository reconstruction, terminal use, system optimization, and ML research.
r: IC1: audit of general agent benchmarks, mostly not software development.

q: short-horizon repair—given a failing signal, produce a patch
r: EC6: a data factory for training and benchmark tasks, mainly issue repair, not an evaluation method for feature-level development.

q: We propose CodeTeam, a multi-agent framework for repo-level code generation

q: This survey examines agentic artifact creation
r: IC1: survey of agentic creation of all artifact types (text, video, audio), software only one family.
